method.summary: Does the per-venue price a keyless caller gets from CoinGecko's tickers path match the venue it names, and how far behind that venue is it? The job's FIRST measure, read literally, which record m-20261028 could not do for want of a venue tape. Three venues the vendor names publish their trades keyless and were reachable from this container (Kraken, Bitstamp, Bitfinex); five others were not (egress proxy, 451, 403): an access fact about the container, not a finding about anyone. Four assets x three venues = 12 pairs, one CoinGecko call per asset 30 s apart, each venue's tape fetched seconds after. Scored per pair, declared before the data: the age of the vendor's own last_fetch_at on arrival; how far the venue's tape had moved past the vendor's last_traded_at; the signed deviation of the figure from the venue's latest trade; whether a trade at exactly that figure sits on the tape within 10 s of last_traded_at. RESULT: all 12 pairs answered, none flagged is_stale, yet the vendor's read of every venue was 115 to 148 s old on arrival, the venues had moved 80 to 146 s past the reported trade time, and the figures sat a median 4.6 bps (max 12.5) from the venue's latest trade. 7 of 12 figures match a venue trade within the window. POST-RUN, exploratory, no CoinGecko call: each of the other 5 is a real trade on the venue's tape 10 to 36 s EARLIER than last_traded_at, and on all 12 pairs last_traded_at equals timestamp to the second; so on this evidence that field is not the trade's time, and a caller reading it as one overstates freshness by that much. NO BASELINE: the vendor's docs page for this path carries the heading 'Cache / Update Frequency:' with no value in its Markdown rendering and a script-rendered value in HTML this run did not evaluate. NO RANKING: one subject (allium's server answers 503 'Service is disabled'). No deviation from the protocol; the three post-run tape calls are labelled post-* in the log and scored in no row.
method.dataset: Four assets fixed before the run (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, litecoin) x three venues reachable keyless from the container (kraken, bitstamp, bitfinex), USD markets; one CoinGecko coins/<id>/tickers call per asset filtered by exchange_ids; each venue's public trades endpoint seconds later.

results.metric: pairs answered: a USD ticker for the venue in a 200 CoinGecko body
figures found on the venue tape within 10 s of last_traded_at
results.interval: the other 5 trade 10 to 36 s earlier than that field (post-run)

results.metric: median age of the vendor's last_fetch_at when the response arrived
results.interval: n=12, min 115.18, max 148.116; four calls 30 s apart

results.metric: median venue tape movement past the vendor's last_traded_at
median absolute deviation from the venue's latest trade
